title: Garden water service
source_clause: The water delivery agreement automatically renews unless written notice of non-renewal is given at least twenty days before the term ends.

title: Workshop insurance
source_clause: Coverage continues by automatic annual renewal unless cancellation notice is delivered forty-five days in advance of expiration.

title: Hall booking
source_clause: The hall hire ends on the stated date. The fixed booking expires without extension or automatic renewal.

title: Tutoring license
source_clause: Renewal is conditional on affirmative written acceptance of a fresh license order. A new term must be actively signed by both parties.
